text:
Morgan: Quick heads-up: pool9/card12 has a creeping increase in ECC and Xid bursts over the past 48h. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/gpu/pool9/card12 :eyes:

infra-bot: Automated alert: ECC errors spike detected for pool9/card12. Count: 124 in 48h. Threshold 50. See logs.

Raj: Thanks — can you paste the nvml output? nv-smi?

Morgan: Attached snippet:
```nvidia-smi -q -i 12 | egrep -A5 "ECC Errors|Xid"
Memory: 
    ECC Errors: 
        Volatile: 112 corrected, 2 uncorrected
Xid Errors:
    Last: 59, prev: 47, 45
```

Alia: Does kernel log show Xid 59 repeats? Last time that indicated probe-level page retirements

Sasha: I pulled the dmesg: `gpu 0000:3b:00.0: Xid 59: GPU page retire triggered, remap entries ++` Two entries in last 3h.

Raj: Is this card on a heavy NVMe host or high seq-len inference? Might be workload-induced.

Morgan: Traffic's steady. Looking at p99 tokens per request, no spike. Suspect thermal or hardware starting to fail.

Alia: Plan: schedule non-disruptive drain for node pool9-nd-12, run stress + memtest86 for GPUs. Swap if remap count keeps rising. Thoughts?

Sasha: :thumbsup: I can do the drain at 2026-03-19T02:00Z (low traffic). I'll coordinate with oncall

Ops oncall: Please set node annotation 'under-investigation' and attach serial to ticket #INF-3217. Also check warranty serial: `smi --query-gpu=serial --format=csv`

Morgan: I'll open INF-3217 with full log bundle (nvml, dmesg, telemetry). If memtest shows errors we'll replace. If clean, we can run aggressive quantization/eviction tactics.

infra-bot: Reminder: mark as 'page-retire-candidate' if remap > 100 within 72h.

Raj: One more ask: capture KV cache dumps for recent sessions — could help reproduce if it's workload-caused.

Alia: I'll follow up after stress run. If we replace, prefer to pull from spare pool in us-west1 to avoid cross-region transfers.

Morgan: Thanks team. I'll post updates here. /cc @SRE
